problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must assign a collection of archival boxes to identical storage lockers. The items to be stored are:

* Document Set Alpha: volume 56 cubic feet
* Document Set Beta: volume 35 cubic feet
* Document Set Gamma: volume 53 cubic feet
* Document Set Delta: volume 67 cubic feet
* Document Set Epsilon: volume 35 cubic feet
* Document Set Zeta: volume 50 cubic feet
* Document Set Eta: volume 54 cubic feet
* Document Set Theta: volume 37 cubic feet
* Document Set Iota: volume 62 cubic feet
* Document Set Kappa: volume 50 cubic feet
* Document Set Lambda: volume 33 cubic feet
* Document Set Mu: volume 34 cubic feet
* Document Set Nu: volume 33 cubic feet
* Document Set Xi: volume 48 cubic feet
* Document Set Omicron: volume 49 cubic feet
* Document Set Pi: volume 32 cubic feet
* Document Set Rho: volume 40 cubic feet
* Document Set Sigma: volume 36 cubic feet
* Document Set Tau: volume 53 cubic feet
* Document Set Upsilon: volume 52 cubic feet
* Document Set Phi: volume 48 cubic feet
* Document Set Chi: volume 40 cubic feet
* Document Set Psi: volume 59 cubic feet
* Document Set Omega: volume 57 cubic feet
* Document Set Digamma: volume 42 cubic feet
* Document Set San: volume 45 cubic feet
* Document Set Qoppa: volume 35 cubic feet
* Document Set Sampi: volume 37 cubic feet
* Document Set Sho: volume 56 cubic feet
* Document Set Fai: volume 40 cubic feet
* Document Set Tsan: volume 61 cubic feet
* Document Set Janj: volume 67 cubic feet
* Document Set Ghain: volume 63 cubic feet
* Document Set Heth: volume 59 cubic feet
* Document Set Teth: volume 64 cubic feet
* Document Set Yodh: volume 63 cubic feet
* Document Set Kaph: volume 41 cubic feet
* Document Set Lamedh: volume 30 cubic feet
* Document Set Mem: volume 36 cubic feet

Each storage locker can accommodate a maximum total volume of 100 cubic feet. The coordinator must place every archival box into exactly one locker, ensuring the combined volume within any given locker does not surpass its capacity. The objective is to utilize the smallest possible number of lockers to complete this assignment.
